description_en: Queries the list of hybrid cloud domain names
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-00000000000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --backend 1.1.XX.XX --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cname-enabled true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmvtc5z520000 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name
parameters.help_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名
parameters.name: backend

parameters.help_en: The page number to return when paging is used. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public cloud disaster recovery. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾
parameters.name: cname_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
